the fable / sol summaries are getting more and more absurdly information-dense
1 in every 5 words is a novel compound word (ex: “rate-adjacent”) which itself is the model’s invented stand-in for a metaconcept that it developed that i need to interrogate it about
how to fix this?

— Ashwinee Panda (@PandaAshwinee) July 18, 2026
